data.one_liner: Flutter plugin for the Volcengine RTC real-time audio and video communication SDK.
data.what_it_does: Provides native RTC APIs to implement real-time audio and video communication, streaming, and conferencing features in your application.
use_when: You need real-time audio and video calling features powered by Volcengine RTC.
You are building communication applications requiring live streaming, screen sharing, or room management.
avoid_when: You are building simple media playback or audio recording without peer-to-peer or server-assisted real-time communication.
You prefer a different cloud RTC vendor.
strengths: Integrates Volcengine RTC SDK natively for Android and iOS.
Supports audio and video stream publishing, subscribing, and callbacks.
weaknesses: Requires platform-specific configuration for iOS (Podfile sources and Info.plist permissions) and Android (maven repositories).
Documentation may reference external or non-standard guides.
data.setup_notes: Requires adding the Volcengine maven repository to Android build.gradle, configuring the specific Podfile source for iOS, and setting camera and microphone usage permissions.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:volc_engine_rtc/volc_engine_rtc.dart';

// Add volc_engine_rtc to your pubspec.yaml and configure native dependencies.
